name: CyTools_MeshStudio
description: Mesh studio: specialised operations (reconstruction, views, remesh, UV, PBR, rig, motion, editing) and complete workflows that chain them, in one standalone application usable through its interface, the CLI and MCP.
author: Cyberalien
distributionStatus: Standalone Windows delivery: launcher, ImGui interface, CLI and MCP run. Eight engines built and eighteen of the twenty backends executed here; WHAM waits for the SMPL body model, which is accepted in person. Updates are implemented and tested on a fixture release, never against a published one. The validation report is kept with the installation (data/reports/VALIDATION.md).

operations.name: Quad remesh (AutoRemesher)
operations.description: Rebuild the topology as a quad dominant mesh with the official AutoRemesher program. Geometry only: UV sets and materials of the input are not carried over, and the quad target is approximate.

operations.description: Field aligned quadrangulation of a triangulated mesh with the official QuadWild Bi-MDF binaries. Slower than AutoRemesher and bounded by a solver time limit, but follows the curvature field.

operations.name: Bake PBR channels
operations.description: Bake Base Color, Metallic, Roughness and Alpha into a UV atlas, plus the glTF packed metallic-roughness map. Colour carried by the mesh is baked; channels the mesh does not carry are derived with documented deterministic heuristics, not generated by a model.

mesh_file.description: Mesh path inside the configured mesh root: GLB, GLTF, OBJ, PLY, STL, OFF.

x-cy-ui.help: Relative to CYTOOLS_TRELLIS2TEXTURE_MESH_ROOT; absolute paths must stay inside it.

resolution.description: Square size in texels of every generated map.

uv_mode.description: auto keeps existing UV and unwraps only when there is none; keep fails without UV; unwrap rebuilds an atlas with xatlas and falls back to grid if xatlas fails; grid gives every triangle its own cell, which never overlaps but wastes texels.

padding_pixels.description: Texels of nearest-neighbour padding grown around each UV island.

cavity_delight.description: Brightens concave areas to attenuate shading baked into the source colour. Geometric heuristic, not an inverse-rendering de-lighting.

metallic_mode.description: constant writes metallic_value; estimate applies the documented colour heuristic; source resamples the metallic-roughness texture of the mesh.

metallic_value.description: Constant metallic, and lower bound of the estimated metallic.

roughness_mode.description: estimate applies the documented detail heuristic; constant writes roughness_value; source resamples the mesh metallic-roughness texture.

roughness_value.description: Constant roughness, and centre of the estimated roughness.

alpha_mode.description: from_source keeps the source transparency; opaque writes white; from_coverage marks the texels covered by a triangle, without padding.

export_glb.description: Also write a GLB carrying the UV layout and the generated PBR material.

padding_pixels.description: Padding actually applied; grid mode lowers it to fit its cells.

texel_coverage.description: Fraction of texels covered by a triangle, before padding.

padded_coverage.description: Fraction of texels holding a value after padding.

stamped_faces.description: Triangles smaller than a texel, forced onto a single texel.

x-cy-origin.note: Schemas reused verbatim from the absorbed Tool.

operations.name: Inspect a mesh
operations.description: Report geometry, UV, colour source, materials and transparency of a mesh, plus the settings recommended before baking.

mesh_file.description: Mesh path inside the configured mesh root: GLB, GLTF, OBJ, PLY, STL, OFF.

x-cy-ui.help: Relative to CYTOOLS_TRELLIS2TEXTURE_MESH_ROOT; absolute paths must stay inside it.

operations.name: Image to mesh (TripoSR)
operations.description: Reconstruct one object from a single image in seconds: feed-forward NeRF then marching cubes, vertex colours or a baked texture atlas. Fast prototyping, not a measurement of the real object.

image_file.description: PNG/JPEG/WEBP inside CYTOOLS_TRIPOSR_INPUT_ROOT (default: inputs). Optional when subject_set is given.

mc_resolution.description: Marching cubes grid resolution. Lower is faster and coarser.

x-cy-ui.help: Isosurface level in the predicted density field. Higher shrinks the surface.
Triplane query batch. Smaller uses less VRAM and is slower; 0 disables chunking.

output_format.description: GLB carries vertex colours. Baking a texture atlas requires obj.

bake_texture.description: Bake a texture atlas with xatlas and moderngl instead of vertex colours. Needs a working OpenGL context and output_format obj.

remove_background.description: Run rembg on the input. Disable only for an image that already has a clean, centred foreground.

foreground_ratio.description: Fraction of the frame occupied by the object after cropping.

device.description: CPU is supported by the upstream code but is far slower; it is not a validated path here.

gpu_index.description: NVIDIA device index, ignored when device is cpu.

preview_views.description: Number of NeRF-rendered turntable PNG previews. 0 skips rendering.

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject; its front cut-out replaces the image and switches the internal background removal off.

texture_file.description: Empty string when vertex colours are used.

remesh.description: GLB triangulates faces even after quad remeshing.

target_vertices.description: Approximate remeshing vertex target; -1 preserves upstream default.

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject; its front cut-out replaces the image and switches the internal background removal off.

operations.name: Image or photos to a textured mesh (LocalMesh)
operations.description: LocalMesh: one image, or four photographs of the same subject, to a textured GLB. The TRELLIS.2 model generates the shape; the mesh is then cleaned, remeshed and decimated, and its PBR texture is generated for that final mesh, with a baked normal map. Local CUDA inference.

front.title: Front image
front.description: Image path: absolute local path or relative to data/inputs. Automatically copied into the private job workspace; no manual import required. PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most 32 MiB and 40 megapixels. Optional when subject_set is given.

right.title: Right image
right.description: Image path: absolute local path or relative to data/inputs. Automatically copied into the private job workspace; no manual import required. PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most 32 MiB and 40 megapixels.

left.title: Left image
left.description: Image path: absolute local path or relative to data/inputs. Automatically copied into the private job workspace; no manual import required. PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most 32 MiB and 40 megapixels.

back.title: Back image
back.description: Image path: absolute local path or relative to data/inputs. Automatically copied into the private job workspace; no manual import required. PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most 32 MiB and 40 megapixels.

tier.title: Quality
tier.description: draft: 512 grid, 80 000 faces, 2K atlas, to judge the shape. standard: 1024 grid, 150 000 faces, 4K atlas. high: 1024 grid, 16 passes, 250 000 faces, 4K atlas. max: 1536 grid, 400 000 faces, 8K atlas; needs a 24 GB card, and with four photos it uses the older view mixer because the four-view models stop at 1024.

keep_input_copies.title: Keep input copies after processing
keep_input_copies.description: By default private input copies are deleted after the worker stops, including failure/cancellation. Enable only to retain them for debugging. Original files and generated outputs are never deleted.

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject. Its cut-outs are used as the views, so the subject is segmented once for the whole workflow instead of once per backend.

grid_resolution.description: Grid the shape was really sampled on. The 1536 cascade lowers it by steps of 128 when the object has more tokens than the card allows.

token_cap.description: Token ceiling applied, taken on the memory available at the start of the job.

x-cy-origin.note: Schemas reused verbatim from the absorbed Tool, plus the optional fields listed in ADDITIONS.

operations.name: Construct a proxy mesh from pictures
operations.description: Build a simple, clean, mostly hard-surface proxy mesh (lofted cross-sections, extruded polygons, boxes, cylinders) from one or several pictures of the same object, and project the pictures on it. AI models only supply masks, relative depth, camera poses and optional synthetic views.

image.description: Picture of the object (PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, TIFF; 64 MiB max). An absolute path on the Tool host is accepted and imported automatically into the private job workspace; an alpha channel is used as the object mask.

label.description: Optional human view label. Internally converted to continuous angles. For Top/Bottom the in-plane orientation is searched automatically unless azimuth is given.

azimuth.description: Degrees around the vertical axis: 0 = camera in front of the object, 90 = camera on the object's right side, 180 = behind. Overrides label.

elevation.description: Degrees above (+) or below (-) the horizontal plane.

roll.description: Camera roll in degrees, 0 when the horizon is level.

fov.description: Field of view of the FULL picture along its longest side, in degrees. 0 = orthographic drawing. Default 35.

weight.description: Confidence weight of this real view (default 1.0).

mask.description: Optional object mask (white = object). Replaces automatic segmentation for this picture.

box.description: Optional SAM prompt box [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalised to the picture, when the object is not the salient central subject.

images.description: One to twelve real pictures of the SAME object. Real pictures always win over synthetic data.

image.description: Synthetic view produced by a novel-view model (Zero123++, SyncDreamer, Wonder3D...). Never trusted like a photograph.

source.description: Index in `images` of the real picture the view was generated from.

relative_azimuth.description: Requested azimuth relative to the source picture, degrees.

fov.description: Field of view of the generator camera (Zero123++ v1.2: 30).

weight.description: Weight of this synthetic view (default generated_view_weight).

mask.description: Optional mask of the synthetic view.

generated_views.description: Optional synthetic views with their requested poses. They only vote with a reduced weight and can never carve away what a real picture shows.

segmentation_model.description: SAM 2.1 checkpoint for the object mask. auto = preferred installed model, else classical segmentation (alpha / plain background / GrabCut). none = classical only.

depth_model.description: Depth Anything V2 checkpoint (relative depth, low-confidence cue). Base and Large are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and require a personal licence acceptance.

camera_model.description: Perspective Fields (Paramnet-360Cities-edina-centered): roll, pitch (elevation = -pitch) and field of view of each real picture. Applied only to values the user did not give and only when the picture shows a scene; on a cut-out object the cue is reported but not used. Adobe Research License, non-commercial: personal acceptance required.

device.description: Device of the AI understanding stage. auto = CUDA when PyTorch sees it, else CPU. The fitting engine always runs on the CPU.

view_synthesis.description: Missing-view generation with Zero123++ v1.2 (six views at known poses from one real picture, CUDA only). auto = only when the Real Coverage Score is below synthesis_coverage_threshold and the model is installed; always = generate or fail; off = never. Generated views vote with generated_view_weight and never override a real picture.

view_synthesis_model.description: Missing-view generator. auto = first installed of Zero123++ v1.2 (6 views, absolute elevations +20/-10, FOV 30), Wonder3D v1.0 (6 orthographic views in the frame of the input picture, colour + normals) and SyncDreamer (16 views at a fixed elevation of 30 degrees). Wonder3D and SyncDreamer run in their own environment and pinned source checkout (Installation tab). All need a CUDA GPU.

synthesis_source.description: Index in `images` of the picture given to Zero123++. -1 = first picture that is not a top/bottom view.

synthesis_steps.description: Diffusion steps of the generator. Omitted = its own default (Zero123++ 36, Wonder3D 50, SyncDreamer 50).

synthesis_seed.description: Zero123++ random seed. The same seed, weights and runtime give the same views; bit-exact reproduction across GPUs is not promised.

synthesis_guidance.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Omitted = the generator default (Zero123++ 4.0, Wonder3D 3.0, SyncDreamer 2.0).

synthesis_coverage_threshold.description: view_synthesis = auto generates views when the Real Coverage Score is below this value.

symmetry.description: Mirror plane normal. Auto measures bilateral symmetry (normal = Z, left/right) from several views, or assumes it for a single picture. Force X = front/back, Force Y = top/bottom, Force Z = left/right.

use_depth.description: Use the depth maps for pose estimation and concavity carving.

register_views.description: Classical registration of real views (OpenCV SIFT + essential matrix) for pictures without a pose.

refine_poses.description: Refine unposed views by silhouette coherence.

default_azimuth.description: Azimuth assumed when nothing else is known (degrees).

default_elevation.description: Elevation assumed when nothing else is known (degrees).

default_fov.description: Field of view assumed for pictures without one (degrees, 0 = orthographic).

mirrored_view_weight.description: Weight of mirrored real views, multiplied by the symmetry confidence.

single_view_symmetry_confidence.description: Confidence of the assumed symmetry when it cannot be measured.

symmetry_threshold.description: Auto symmetry: minimal ratio of silhouette coherence with/without mirrored views.

depth_margin.description: Depth carving safety margin, fraction of the object size.

complexity.description: Budget preset. UltraSimple: 2-4 sections, about 20-100 triangles. Simple: 4-8 sections, 100-500. Medium: 8-16 sections, 500-2000. Targets, not hard limits.

main_axis.description: Axis of the main loft. X = front/back, Y = up, Z = left/right.

max_sections.description: Override: maximum cross-sections of the main loft.

section_vertices.description: Override: vertices per rounded cross-section (box sections always use 4).

max_primitives.description: Override: maximum fitted components besides the main body (a mirrored pair counts once).

max_polygon_vertices.description: Override: maximum outline vertices of an extruded polygon.

grid_resolution.description: Override: support volume resolution per axis (RAM grows with the cube).

min_part_volume.description: Override: smallest component kept, as a fraction of the support volume.

unobserved_extent_ratio.description: When no picture limits the object along an axis (single front view, two opposite views), its extent on that axis is assumed to be this ratio times the largest observed dimension. The report lists every assumed axis.

body_window.description: Appendages shorter than this fraction of the main axis are separated from the body.

min_gain.description: Progressive optimisation: a section or component is kept only if FitScore improves by more than this.

split_below.description: A component fitted below this volumetric IoU is split (plate peeling) and refitted.

snap_angle.description: Hard-surface snapping: directions and outline edges closer than this to an axis become exactly parallel/perpendicular (degrees). 0 disables.

thin_as_planes.description: Represent one-voxel-thin surfaces as zero-thickness double-sided Plane primitives.

min_thickness_ratio.description: Thinnest allowed plate, relative to its largest outline span.

refine_passes.description: Coordinate-descent passes of the final silhouette refinement.

part_triangle_penalty.description: Per-triangle penalty when choosing the primitive type of a component.

fit_weights.description: FitScore weights. Defaults: silhouette 1.0, depth 0.25, edge 0.35, multiview 0.4, symmetry 0.15, complexity_primitive 0.004, complexity_triangle 0.002 (per 100 triangles).

texture_blend.description: best = best camera per face. blend = weighted multi-view blend of the best cameras.

blend_views.description: Cameras mixed per face when texture_blend = blend.

visibility_resolution.description: Depth-buffer size of the occlusion test.

min_facing.description: A camera may texture a face only when cos(angle) exceeds this.

mirrored_view_bonus.description: TextureViewScore factor of mirrored real pictures.

target_size.description: Largest dimension of the exported mesh, in glTF units (metres). Relative proportions only: no absolute scale is recovered from pictures.

weld_tolerance.description: Vertex welding distance of proxy_geometry.obj, relative to target_size.

mesh_file.description: Merged textured proxy (binary glTF, front +Z, up +Y). Internal faces removed. Input of any mesh Tool.

parts_file.description: Separated parts: one named node per primitive, same atlas.

silhouette_agreement.description: Weighted silhouette IoU over all views.

report_file.description: JSON report: views, poses, coverage, scores, primitives, optimisation trace, texture sources.

preview_file.description: PNG contact sheet: mask (green), support volume (yellow), proxy outline (red) for every view.

real_coverage_score.description: Real Coverage Score, 0..1 over the view sphere.

expected_reconstruction_confidence.description: 0..1; capped at 0.5 for a single picture.

is_hypothesis.description: True when only one real picture was available.

understanding.description: Models and device actually used, measured peak VRAM.

operations.name: Prepare the subject (shared front end)
operations.description: Cut the subject out of every view once, at a common scale, and measure where each photograph was taken from. The result is a subject set that every reconstruction backend can consume, instead of each one carrying its own background remover and its own camera estimate.

front.description: Reference view of the subject. Optional when images are given.

images.description: Views of the same subject. Without a front view, the role of each is read from its file name (front, right, left, back, or face, droite, gauche, dos); the first one without a role becomes the front.

common_framing.description: Cut every view at one common scale. Required by a multi-view fusion: framing each view on its own scales an elongated object differently per view.

measure_camera.description: Measure the azimuth of each view instead of assuming a regular turntable.

contact_sheet.description: Write a contact sheet of the prepared views.

subject_set.description: Folder holding the prepared views and their description.

contact_sheet.description: Contact sheet of the prepared views.

operations.name: Complete the subject with generated views (Wonder3D)
operations.description: From one picture, generate the right, left and back views with Wonder3D around the vertical axis of the picture, then cut the four views out at one common scale: a subject set for the four-view path of LocalMesh. Only for a level front view: with a three-quarter or top view the generated views are tilted and the fusion deforms the object. The generated views are marked as such, and LocalMesh measures their angles itself.

image.description: Reference picture of the subject (the front).

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject; its front cut-out is used.

contact_sheet.description: The four views side by side.

wonder3d_folder.description: The six raw Wonder3D views and their normal maps.

operations.name: Image to mesh (Hi3DGen)
operations.description: Hi3DGen (Stable-X): the picture becomes a sharp normal map (StableNormal YOSO), and a TRELLIS v1 retrained on normal maps turns that normal map into a mesh. Geometry only, on a 256 grid, in the same frame as the LocalMesh output: texture it with "Texture a mesh for its own topology", or regenerate its detail on the 1536 grid first with "Refine a mesh". A picture without transparency is cut out first with the shared front end.

image.description: Picture of the subject. With an alpha channel it is used as it is; otherwise it is cut out with BiRefNet first.

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject or complete_subject: its front cut-out is used.

normal_resolution.description: Resolution of the normal map estimation.
normal_resolution.title: Normal map resolution

ss_steps.description: Sampling steps of the sparse structure.
ss_steps.title: Structure steps

slat_steps.description: Sampling steps of the structured latent.
slat_steps.title: Detail steps

origin_at_base.description: Put the base of the object on the ground plane.

normal_file.description: The normal map the geometry was generated from.

prepared_file.description: The cut-out, cropped and padded as the model saw it.

subject_set.description: The subject set used, when one was prepared.

operations.name: Refine a mesh with TRELLIS.2 (LocalMesh)
operations.description: Regenerate the geometric detail of an existing mesh, keeping its overall shape: the mesh is encoded, its occupancy becomes the structure, and TRELLIS.2 samples the shape again on it from the reference picture, up to the 1536 grid. LocalMesh's own cleaning chain then closes the holes, removes the debris and brings it to the face budget, in the frame and at the scale of the input. Geometry only: texture the result with "Texture a mesh for its own topology".

mesh_file.description: Mesh to refine, Y-up and facing like the LocalMesh output.

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject or complete_subject: the reference cut-out.

image.description: Reference picture, when there is no subject set; it is cut out here.

resolution.description: Grid the shape is sampled on again. 1536 needs a 24 GB card and is lowered by steps of 128 when the shape has too many tokens.

target_faces.description: Face budget of the result; 0 takes the recipe of that grid (250 000 on 1024, 400 000 on 1536).

use_all_views.description: Condition on every view of the subject set, not only the front. Experimental.

steps.description: Sampling steps of the shape model.

guidance.description: Shape guidance; 0 keeps the weights' own value.

up_axis.description: Up axis of the input mesh.

operations.name: Texture a mesh for its own topology (LocalMesh)
operations.description: Give a remeshed model — QuadWild quads, a retopology, any mesh aligned with the reference — a texture made for that exact topology. "generate" asks TRELLIS.2 to generate it on this mesh from the reference picture, as LocalMesh does on its own mesh; "transfer" re-projects the texture of the detailed model instead, with no model. The detailed model, when given, is also baked into a normal map. Quads are kept in the OBJ; the GLB is triangulated, as glTF requires.

mesh_file.description: Mesh to texture (OBJ keeps its quads; GLB, PLY, STL are read as triangles). Y-up, facing like the LocalMesh output.

subject_set.description: Folder produced by prepare_subject or complete_subject: the reference cut-out, and the other views for multi-view texturing.

image.description: Reference picture, when there is no subject set; it is cut out here.

detail_mesh.description: Detailed model aligned with this mesh (the LocalMesh output): baked into the normal map, and the source of "transfer".

texture_source.description: generate: TRELLIS.2 generates the texture on this mesh. transfer: the texture of the detailed model is re-projected.

texture_size.description: Side of the atlas in pixels.

multiview_texture.description: Guide the texture with every view of the subject set, not only the front. Experimental: never measured upstream.

resolution.description: Texture model grid: 512 uses the 512 model, 1024 the 1024 one.

steps.description: Sampling steps of the texture model.

up_axis.description: Up axis of the input mesh.

uv_padding.description: Padding between UV islands, in texels.

file.description: Textured GLB (triangulated, PBR with normal map).

obj_file.description: Textured OBJ that keeps the quads, with its MTL.

normal_file.description: Tangent-space normal map, when a detailed model was given.

operations.name: Run a workflow
operations.description: Run a saved chain of operations on one input or on every file of a folder. Each step is submitted as a real job on the same runtime as the interface, the CLI and MCP.

workflow_name.description: Name of a workflow saved in data/workflows.

workflow.description: Inline workflow document, instead of a saved name.

input_mode.description: What a folder given as input means. each: the workflow runs once per file. together: it runs once, and its first step receives every file as one list: the photographs of one subject, whose roles prepare_subject reads from the file names.

operation.description: Operation id, as declared by this manifest.

backend.description: Backend id, when the operation supports several.

input_from.description: Step id whose output feeds this step; empty means the workflow input.

input_field.description: Output field of that step to use as the input.

input_to.description: Parameter of this step that receives it; empty uses the field the operation normally reads its input from.

extra_inputs.description: More values taken from earlier steps, when one input is not enough: a retexturing step needs the new topology, the detailed original and the prepared views.

from.description: Earlier step id, or @input for the workflow input.

field.description: Output field of that step; empty takes its main output.

to.description: Parameter of this step that receives it.

id.description: Identifier of this step inside the workflow.

continue_on_error.description: Keep going when this step fails: what it received is handed on, as when it is switched off, and the failure is listed in the report.

input_folder.description: Folder to process instead of a single file.

input_mode.description: Overrides the input mode of the workflow: each (one run per file) or together (one run with every file). Empty: the workflow decides.

keep_intermediate.description: Keep the output of every step, not only the last one.

stop_on_error.description: Stop the whole workflow at the first failed step.

outputs.description: Final files produced by the workflow.

operations.name: Save a workflow
operations.description: Write a workflow document to data/workflows so that the interface, the CLI and MCP can run it by name.

input_mode.description: What a folder given as input means. each: the workflow runs once per file. together: it runs once, and its first step receives every file as one list: the photographs of one subject, whose roles prepare_subject reads from the file names.

operation.description: Operation id, as declared by this manifest.

backend.description: Backend id, when the operation supports several.

input_from.description: Step id whose output feeds this step; empty means the workflow input.

input_field.description: Output field of that step to use as the input.

input_to.description: Parameter of this step that receives it; empty uses the field the operation normally reads its input from.

extra_inputs.description: More values taken from earlier steps, when one input is not enough: a retexturing step needs the new topology, the detailed original and the prepared views.

from.description: Earlier step id, or @input for the workflow input.

field.description: Output field of that step; empty takes its main output.

to.description: Parameter of this step that receives it.

id.description: Identifier of this step inside the workflow.

continue_on_error.description: Keep going when this step fails: what it received is handed on, as when it is switched off, and the failure is listed in the report.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing workflow with the same name.

operations.name: List the workflows
operations.description: List the workflows saved in data/workflows with their steps and the operations they use.

include_steps.description: Include the full step list of every workflow.

operations.name: Install or repair an engine
operations.description: Create or repair one of the engine environments declared in app/engines.json, including the upstream sources it needs. Downloads happen here, never during an inference job.

device.description: Build the CUDA variant or the CPU variant when the engine offers one.

repair.description: Reinstall even when the engine reports itself as installed.

sources_only.description: Only fetch or update the upstream sources.

operations.name: Install or repair a model
operations.description: Download the weights of a model that is declared but absent, into data/models. Files whose licence is accepted in person are never downloaded here: the answer names them, and import_model_file puts them in place once obtained.

model.description: Model identifier, as list_models reports it.

repair.description: Download again even when the files are already present.

skip_optional.description: Leave the optional files out (global motion for WHAM).

operations.name: Import a licensed model file
operations.description: Put in place a file the user downloaded themselves after accepting its licence, such as the SMPL body model. The application never asks for the credentials of those sites; it checks the file, copies it into data/models and records its hash.

model.description: Model identifier, as list_models reports it.

file.description: The file downloaded from the official page (.pkl, or the .zip holding it).

target.description: Which declared file this is, when the model expects several.

operations.name: Update state
operations.description: Where the three streams stand: the application version and its repository, what is staged, what is pending for the next start, the backups kept, the engines and their pinned revisions, and the model catalogue. Reads local files only.

operations.name: Check for an update
operations.description: Ask the configured GitHub repository for its latest release and compare it with the installed version. The engines and the weights streams answer from local files: they are updated by reinstalling an engine or a model, not by a release.

repository.description: GitHub repository owner/name; saved in data/settings/updates.json.

release_file.description: A release description already on disk, instead of asking GitHub (used by the tests).

operations.name: Stage an update
operations.description: Download or copy a release archive, check its SHA-256 when one is given, unpack it under runtime/updates and verify it holds this Tool and no data folder. Nothing is activated: the running application is untouched.

source.description: URL of the release asset, or a local .zip.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the archive; refused when it differs.

version.description: Name of the staging folder; defaults to the archive digest.

operations.name: Activate a staged update
operations.description: Verify a staged update once more and record the swap for the next start. The folders are exchanged by a separate process before the application loads, so the running code is never replaced underneath itself, the previous app folder is kept as a backup, and data/ is not touched.

staged.description: Staged folder; the most recent one when left empty.

operations.name: Roll back to a backup
operations.description: Record the reverse swap: the next start restores a kept backup of the app folder. Cancelling instead drops a pending request. Your data is never part of either move.

backup.description: Backup folder to restore; the most recent one when left empty.

cancel.description: Drop the pending request instead of rolling back.

operations.name: Diagnose the installation
operations.description: Report the state of every engine, backend, native program and model: what is installed, what is missing, and which device each backend would really use.

engine.description: Restrict the report to one engine.

deep.description: Also start each installed engine to report its real torch and device.

operations.name: List the models
operations.description: List every model of the catalogue with its family, its engine, its size on disk, its licence and whether it is installed.

installed_only.description: Only the models present on disk.
